title: 第三章：别催！床上忙着呢！
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

就在姜枝和系统达成初步共识的时候，现实里，一直安静坐在石床边的苍凛忽然抬起眼。

他把姜枝刚才那几息沉默理解成了另一种意思。

“您要动手了吗？”他低声问。

正在和系统喵讨价还价的姜枝一秒回神：“什么动手？”

苍凛垂着眼，语气平静。

“不是要继续昨晚的事么。”

“如果您想，现在也可以。”说着，苍凛递来了用荆棘做成的鞭子。

姜枝：“……”

不，即便是回不去了，她也不会走上被安排好的道路。

而且，她没有兴趣虐待一个长在她审美上的人。

枝在心里深吸一口气，对着离婚对象，硬着头皮开口：

“昨晚的事先不提。”

苍凛眼睫微微一动，却没说话。

姜枝看着他肩上那道裂开的旧伤，尽量让自己的语气听起来正常一点。

“你……过来。”

这句话一出口，苍凛的眼神瞬间更冷了。

像是意料之中，又像是在等那把终于落下来的刀。

他沉默了两秒，还是顺从地靠近了些。

兽人和普通男人的体格差距，根本不是“大一点”这么简单。

苍凛一靠近，肩背几乎把洞里的光都压暗了一截，胸膛宽阔结实，肌肉随着呼吸微微起伏，绷出饱满又凌厉的线条，往下却偏偏收得极紧，腰际利落窄硬，拉出一道极有力量感的弧度。

她毫不怀疑，这狼男要是真抬手给她一下，自己大概会当场从石床这头飞到石床那头。

任务还没开始，已经感受到地狱模式的气息了。

幸好系统喵给她科普过，兽世男多女少，每一位雌性都是尊贵的存在。

任何兽男如果被发现伤害雌性，是要被处死的、

即使原主的兽夫们有心杀妻，也应该是使用了什么隐秘的手段，不会光明正大拍死她。

反正不是普通物理攻击就行。

姜枝还是很乐观的。

处理伤口。这个她熟啊。

别的不敢说，给猫猫狗狗清创、上药、包扎，她可是专业的。

区区一头大狼……。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Just when Jiang Zhi and the system reached an initial consensus, in reality, Cang Lin, who had been sitting quietly beside the stone bed, suddenly raised his eyes.

He interpreted Jiang Zhi's silence just now as another meaning.

"Are you going to take action?" he asked in a low voice.

Jiang Zhi, who was bargaining with System Meow, came back to his senses in a second: "What action?"

Cang Lin lowered his eyes and spoke calmly.

"Don't you want to continue what happened last night?"

"If you want, you can do it now." After saying that, Cang Lin handed over a whip made of thorns.

Jiang Zhi: "..."

No, even if she couldn't go back, she would not follow the arranged path.

Also, she has no interest in abusing someone who looks like her.

Zhi took a deep breath in his heart, faced his divorce partner, and spoke bravely:

"Don't mention last night in advance."

Cang Lin's eyelashes moved slightly, but she didn't speak.

Jiang Zhi looked at the old cracked wound on his shoulder and tried his best to sound normal.

"You...come here."

As soon as these words were spoken, Cang Lin's eyes instantly became colder.

It seemed like it was expected, and it seemed like he was waiting for the knife to finally fall.

He was silent for two seconds and then moved closer obediently.

The physical difference between orcs and ordinary men is not as simple as "bigger".

As soon as Cang Lin came closer, his shoulders and back almost dimmed the light in the cave. His chest was broad and strong, and his muscles undulated slightly with his breathing, stretching out full and sharp lines. However, they tightened down extremely tightly. His waist was sharp, narrow and hard, creating a very powerful arc.

She had no doubt that if the wolf man really raised his hand to her, she would probably fly from one end of the stone bed to the other on the spot.

The mission hasn't even started yet, but I can already feel the atmosphere of hell mode.

Fortunately, System Meow had given her some popular science. In the world of beasts, there were more men than women, and every female was a noble being.

Any beastman caught harming a female will be put to death.

Even if the beastmen of the original owner had the intention to kill his wife, they should have used some secret method and would not have beaten her to death openly.

Anyway, it’s not a normal physical attack.

Jiang Zhi is still very optimistic.

Treat wounds.She is familiar with this.

I dare not say anything else, but she is professional in debriding, applying medicine, and bandaging cats and dogs.

Just a big wolf...
